name: Demidjinn
_notes: Transcribed from sheet DU2434 (Lv I-IX), trait card DX3223 (Wish for a Wish), AI DR2435-DR2456, BP DS2457-DS2474, Global Wish DZ2580-DZ2583.
Lv III/IV right box (+3 / +12) is a campaign value — ignored. BP 'atStair' = AT when attacking from inside the Endless Staircase.

traits.Global Wish: Additional Setup: Take all Global Wish cards with a level equal to or lower than the current Demidjinn level, shuffle them and place them face up on the Global Wish stack. Start of Primordial Round (ignore during the first round): Place the top card from the Global Wish stack in the Active Global Wish space, discarding any card that was already on it. Then, if there are no cards on the Global Wish stack, shuffle all discarded Global Wish cards and place them face up on the Global Wish stack. If a Global Wish card is on the Active Global Wish space, it takes effect during both the Primordial and Titan Rounds.
traits.Living Tornado: The Demidjinn has Unlimited Speed and ignores Line of Sight. It causes Crash as normal, but it does not destroy Terrain tiles, unless stated otherwise.
traits.Wish Away: When the Demidjinn performs Wish Away, it performs: Level 1: Wish Away 9. Level 2: Wish Away 10. Level 3: Wish Away 11. Level 4+: Wish Away 12.
traits.Sandstorm Spiral: If adjacent to a Target, the Demidjinn moves clockwise around the Target, so that it ends up on four spaces directly across the Target. If the movement is blocked by a Board Edge, the Demidjinn moves 6 spaces directly away from the Target without turning instead.
traits.Endless Staircase: You climb using the Endless Staircase Rules (see Cycle IV Storybook rules). Level 1: Staircase has 5 spaces (1 tier). Level 2: 9 spaces (2 tiers). Level 3: 13 spaces (3 tiers). Level 4+: 18 spaces (4 tiers).
traits.Wish for a Wish: Each time the Demidjinn gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds) place a token on this card. After resolving the current action, if there are 3 or more tokens on this card, discard all tokens, then perform Signature.
traits.Curse Carapace: The Demidjinn gains +1 AT for every Wishkeen and Wishagog Condition card in play (but not on dead Titans).
traits.Endless Wish: Every Attack becomes a Wish Attack in addition to its other types.
traits.Feedback Loop: Each time you use Wish Armor against an AI Attack, place 1 token on the Wish for a Wish Trait.
traits.The Last: Battle Setup: Place the special AI 0 card at the bottom of the AI deck. It is never shuffled or discarded. After Escalation: If the top AI card is not an AI IV or AI 0 card, discard it (once per Escalation).
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Djinnian Determination: When the Demidjinn is about to perform Wish Away, turn it toward the closest Board Edge.
traits.Endless Escalator: When there is at least one Titan in the Endless Staircase, at the start of the Primordial Round, move the lowest segment of the Endless Staircase to the top. Titans on the lowest segment die.
traits.Imminent Destruction: End of Titan turn: If you didn't Attack this turn, resolve the top AI card.
traits.Wishtanglement: When you gain a Wishkeen or Wishagog Condition card, every other Titan gains the same Condition card.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Djinnian Precision: Each Wish Away must be performed to the Irem Tower that is exactly X spaces from the Demidjinn, where X is the Wish Away value.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Flickering Wishes: Perform the "Start of Primordial Round" effect of the Global Wish Trait after every Attack (Demidjinn and Titan) instead.

globalWish.name: Sand to Silica
globalWish.text: When you attack, you gain -X Precision, where X is the number of Fire tokens in the Kratos Pool.

globalWish.name: Pillars to Pyres
globalWish.text: When this card is placed on the Active Global Wish space all Irem Tower Terrain tiles become 'pyres'. ⚡ All Titans on pyres die. When you end your voluntary movement or end your turn on a pyre, you die. When you end your involuntary movement on a pyre, ⚡ you die.

globalWish.name: Stones to Sticks
globalWish.text: Irem Tower Terrain tiles gain the Destructible keyword. If you move off an Irem Tower, it is destroyed. If you end your turn on an Irem Tower, it is destroyed, then you suffer Crash.

globalWish.name: Sand to Sea
globalWish.text: Normal (not Terrain) Battle Board spaces are considered Terrain tiles with the Chasm keyword.
